title: Flow-based Phase-space Tomography of Continuous-variable Quantum States
summary: Continuous-variable quantum state tomography is limited by the cost of resolving non-Gaussian structure in high-dimensional phase space. We introduce QST-Flow, a quantum state tomography framework via flow-based generative modeling that represents experimentally accessible phase-space quasiprobability distributions with normalized, samplable neural densities rather than a truncated density matrix.
